annotation.emotional_arc: A steady, quiet longing and grief that remains unchanged from the beginning to the end of the year of separation.

stanzas.loss_note: The translation introduces a rhyme scheme ('ways/stays', 'unbroken/spoken') not present in the original free verse, and alters the final lines from a repetition of 'Since we parted' (तुमसे बिछड़े) to 'Since we last spoken' to force the rhyme.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The persistent, inescapable nature of the beloved's memories which constantly occupy the speaker's mind.
acceptable_visual_variants: A person walking through a crowd with a faint, glowing outline of another person closely following or embracing them like a shadow.
A person looking at their hands or reflection where faint, ghostly images of past memories are overlaid on their body.
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Every moment of your memories is physically stuck/glued to me.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing literal pieces of paper, sticky notes, or a physical substance labeled 'memories' physically glued to a person's skin, which looks comical or bizarre.
metaphor_spans.source_span_original:
तुम्हारी यादों का,
हर क्षण मुझसे चिपका है।
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation:
The memories of you,
Cling to me, unbroken.
metaphor_spans.source_term:
तुम्हारी यादों का,
हर क्षण मुझसे चिपका है।
metaphor_spans.tenor: The persistent mental presence of memories of the beloved.
metaphor_spans.vehicle: A physical object or substance that sticks or clings tightly to a person's body.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a solitary figure sitting in a room, surrounded by a soft, hazy aura or faint, translucent overlapping silhouettes/shadows of past shared moments that closely envelop them.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation introduces the word 'stays' to create a rhyme scheme, which is not present in the original Hindi text.
The translation adds the word 'unbroken' to rhyme with 'spoken', which is not in the original text.
The translation changes 'Since we parted' (tumse bichhde) to 'Since we last spoken' in the final lines to force a rhyme, altering the literal meaning of physical separation to verbal communication.

annotation.theme: The persistent, inescapable presence of a beloved's memory in every breath and moment after a year of separation.

original_poem:
एक बरस हुआ,  
तुमसे बिछड़े।  
हर पल में तुम,  
हर सांस में तुम।  
तुम्हारी यादों का,  
हर क्षण मुझसे चिपका है।  
एक बरस हुआ,  
तुमसे बिछड़े।
translated_poem:
A year has passed,  
Since we parted ways.  
In every moment,  
In every breath, it stays.  
The memories of you,  
Cling to me, unbroken.  
A year has passed,  
Since we last spoken.
